newsitem.title: CHINA: China releases activist after 2-1/2 yrs labour.
newsitem.headline: China releases activist after 2-1/2 yrs labour.

text.p: China on Thursday released democracy activist Tong Yi, secretary to veteran dissident Wei Jingsheng, after she completed a 2-1/2 year term of "re-education through labour".
"My term of labour was very harsh," Tong said in a telephone interview from her home in the central Chinese city of Wuhan.

Tong, the closest associate of veteran dissident Wei who was sentenced to 14 years in jail late last year, had been ordered to serve the administrative punishment of re-education through labour following accusations of forging a seal.
She said she had no immediate plans following her release, but was eager to catch up with events in China and beyond after more than two years with little access to newspapers or other media.
Her labour included folding cardboard boxes and making hair bands, she said.
"Every day was very boring," she said.
